$comment: The court (D-083, core/Court.cpp). Crimes listed under sentences are tried here: an arrest books you (held booking_minutes at the jail) and a report summons you, and either way you are charged and given a court date, the first free slot of the sittings at least notice_minutes away (the courthouse's own open days, sitting.hours, one case a slot). Be in the courthouse at that time; within grace_minutes of it is late but heard. Missed: a warrant (Wanted), unless nobody is playing you, which adjourns it (at most max_adjournments times). At the hearing you plead guilty (convicted, guilty_plea_discount off the sentence) or not guilty (convicted with the chance shown, otherwise dismissed); no plea by plea_minutes and the court enters not guilty. The chance: evidence.caught or evidence.reported, plus each witness, member of staff and officer who saw it, plus the victim when a victim reported it, each witness in the courtroom when the hearing opens counting again (in_court) and the victim there adding victim_in_court, less your lawyer's edge, within min and max. Lawyers: the firm (fee to its account, paid when hired) or a person whose career is in lawyer_careers (fee_cents, paid to them when the hearing opens with them in the courtroom; edge_base plus edge_per_level for each level). sentences: for each crime, by how many convictions you already have (the last entry is for that many or more): fine_cents (to fines_account; if you can't pay it, held unpaid_fine_jail_minutes instead), service_hours (community service at community_service.place within due_days; unserved, a warrant, and arrested you serve breach_jail_minutes_per_hour for each hour left), probation_days (convicted again while on it adds probation.breach_jail_minutes) and jail_minutes. The record: everything stays on it, and employers that need a clean record see a fixed penalty for record.penalty_days, a conviction for record.conviction_days and one with jail time for record.jail_days.
